findings.title: 5 measured text colour pair(s) meet 1.4.3 AA
findings.reason: Computed from rendered styles for the sampled text in the region. Unresolved samples are reported separately.

findings.title: Median 40 characters per line on a 390px viewport
findings.reason: Phones should keep a useful text size and use the available width rather than force a desktop line length (10th–90th percentile 36–44, 38 lines).

findings.title: If you are considering 1.5 vs 1.6 line height, test it
findings.reason: Current ratio 1.5 is inside the starting range. For changing 1.5→1.6: No reliable quantitative improvement established. Compare with fresh passages and separate speed, comprehension and comfort.

findings.title: No content loss detected under WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing
findings.reason: Checked hidden text, spilled text and horizontal scrolling after applying line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2em, letter spacing 0.12em and word spacing 0.16em (document and open shadow roots). Loss of functionality other than hidden text (e.g. broken interactions) is not detected automatically.

findings.title: No content loss detected under 320 CSS px reflow
findings.reason: Checked hidden text, spilled text and horizontal scrolling after rendering at a 320×256 CSS px viewport. Loss of functionality other than hidden text (e.g. broken interactions) is not detected automatically.

findings.title: No content loss detected under 200% zoom (approximation)
findings.reason: Checked hidden text, spilled text and horizontal scrolling after emulating 200% page zoom as a 195×422 CSS px viewport at 6x; browser text-only zoom is not tested. Loss of functionality other than hidden text (e.g. broken interactions) is not detected automatically.

findings.title: Compare a short list of text faces at matched apparent size
findings.reason: No typeface is established as universally fastest; individual results vary. For superiority of any named font: No reliable quantitative improvement established.
